spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (भणति)
To sound, to utter articulate sound, to speak or say.
With प्रति,
to reply.

m. (-णः)
A sort of dramatic entertainment, described as one, in which one only of the interlocutors appears on the scene; or as the narrative of some intrigue, told either by the hero or a third person.
E.
भण to speak, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sounded, spoken, uttered.
E.
भण to speak, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
Speech, speaking.
E.
भण to speak, aff. क्तिन्, with the augment इट्.

f. (-की)
The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)
E.
भट to nourish, aff. आक, and नुम् augment.

m. (-ण्डः)
A mime, a jester, a buffoon, an actor.
E.
भडि to deride, &c. aff. अच्.

m. (-ण्डं)
1 Any vessel, a pot, a cup, a plate, &c.
2 Any musical instrument.
3 Any implement or utensil.
4 Capital, principal.
5 An ornament in general.
6 An ornament round a horse's neck and breast.
7 The bed of a river, the space between its banks.
8 Mimickry, buffoonery, the practice of the Bhaṇḍa or professional jester.
m. (-ण्डः)
A tree, (Hibiscus populneoides.)
E.
भदि to be auspicious, aff. अच्, or भण to sound, aff. ड, deriv. irr., or भण्ड a jester, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A wagtail.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
A cup, a plate, a vessel, or utensil.
n. (-कं)
Goods, merchandise^1.
E.
भाण्ड, and कन् added.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-नं)
1 Armour, mail.
2 War, battle.
3 Evil, wickedness, mischief.
E.
भडि to blame, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-नी)
A whore, a harlot.
E.
भण्ड a jester, and हासिनी who delights.

f. (-ण्डिः-ण्डी)
1 A plant, from the wood of which a red dye is prepared; Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith, Rox.)
2 A wave.
E.
भडि to be auspicious, &c. aff. इन्; also with कन् added भण्डिका, also भण्डिरी and भण्डीरी.

m. (-रः)
A tree, (Mimosa sirisha.)
f. (-री)
Madder.
E.
see भण्डिल, भण्डीरी, &c.

m. (-रः)
The Indian fig tree.
E.
भाण्ड a vessel, ईर to bring, aff. क; referable perhaps to the legend that describes the infant KṚṢṆA, taking his meals under a tree of this kind in the woods of Vṛndāvana.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 A messenger, one sent or dispatched.
2 Fortunate, happy, prosperous, auspicious.
m. (-लः)
A tree, (Mimosa sirisha).
E.
भडि to be happy, &c. Uṇādi aff. इलच्; also र being substituted for ल, भण्डिर, or the short vowel being lengthened, भण्डील.

m. (-लः)
The Sirisha tree: see भण्डिल.

m. (-लः)
A barber.
E.
भाण्ड a vessel, and इलच् aff.

f. (-री)
The Bengal madder tree: see भण्डि.
E.
भडि to be auspicious, ईरन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A flower, (Bignonia Indica.)
E.
भडि to be auspicious, ऊकन् aff.

f. (-का)
A comic drama in one act.
E.
भाण, and कन् dimin. aff.

m. (-टः)
A barber.
E.
भाण्ड a vessel, पुट to rub, aff. क.

m. (-ष्पः)
A sort of snake.

m. (-कः)
Rule of barter, (in arithmetic.)
E.
भाण्ड, and प्रति for, again, भाण्डक goods.

m. (-कः)
The contents of any vessel.
E.
भाण्ड, and भरक what fills.

n. (-नं)
Playing on musical instruments.
E.
भाण्ड, and वादन sounding.

m. (-रः)
A store-room, a place where household goods and utensils are kept.
n. (-रं)
A treasury.
E.
भाण्ड a vessel, and आगार a house.

m. (-कः)
A musician, one especially who is to waken the prince or chief in the morning, by vocal, or instrumental music.
E.
भाण्ड a vessel, (an instrument,) and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि)
Having a vessel, utensil, &c.
E.
भाण्ड, and इनि aff.

m. (-हः)
A barber.
E.
भाण्डि for भाण्डी having a bason, and वाह who works or labours.
